Tours

Every excursion we run, and who each one suits

Nairobi Adventures runs four kinds of day: a game drive in Nairobi National Park, a city excursion around the Karen and Lang’ata attractions, a longer day trip into the Rift Valley or to Amboseli, and a layover tour built around a connecting flight at JKIA. All four are private, all four include pick-up, and all four are quoted with the fees itemised.

All tours
Private, your party only
Pick-up
Nairobi, JKIA and Wilson Airport
Booking
By email or booking form

Choose by the time you have

Four days, compared honestly

The right excursion is decided by how many hours you have and how much driving you are willing to do. This table is the short version, and each tour page gives the full detail.

TourTime neededWhere it goesChoose it when
Nairobi National Park game driveHalf day or full dayStays inside NairobiYou want wildlife and have limited time
Nairobi city excursionsHalf day or full dayKaren and Lang’ataYou want elephants, giraffe, history and craft
Day trips from NairobiFull day, early startRift Valley or AmboseliYou want a change of landscape and will accept the driving

In detail

The four excursions

01

Nairobi National Park game drive

A guided game drive through the only national park inside a capital city, where lions, rhinos and giraffe graze against the Nairobi skyline.

Best for
First-time safari-goers, photographers, families with a free morning
Pick-up
Nairobi hotels, Airbnbs and JKIA
See the Nairobi National Park tour→
02

Nairobi city excursions

The Sheldrick elephant orphanage, the Giraffe Centre, the Karen Blixen Museum, Bomas of Kenya and the Kazuri bead workshop, combined into one unhurried day.

Best for
Visitors with one free day, families with children, culture-first travellers
Pick-up
Nairobi hotels, Airbnbs and JKIA
See the City excursions tour→
03

Day trips from Nairobi

Long single days out of the city to Lake Naivasha, Hell’s Gate, Lake Nakuru, Amboseli, Ngong Hills and the Great Rift Valley, back in Nairobi by evening.

Best for
Travellers without time for an overnight safari, weekend residents
Pick-up
Nairobi hotels, Airbnbs and JKIA
See the Day trips tour→
04

Airport layover tours

A short excursion built around your connecting flight, timed backwards from check-in so you reach the terminal with hours to spare.

Best for
Transit passengers at JKIA with a long connection
Pick-up
Jomo Kenyatta International Airport
See the Layover tours tour→

Before you book

Questions we answer most days

Which Nairobi tour should I choose if I only have one day?+
Take the Nairobi National Park game drive in the morning and add the Karen attractions in the afternoon. That combination gives you wildlife, elephants and giraffe in a single day, because the park gate and the Karen sites are minutes apart on the same side of the city.
Are your tours private or shared?+
Every excursion listed here runs as a private tour for your party alone, which is why departure times, stop lengths and the route can be adjusted on the day. [PLACEHOLDER: confirm whether you also offer shared or seat-in-vehicle departures.]
Do you pick up outside central Nairobi?+
Yes. Pick-up covers Nairobi hotels, apartments, Jomo Kenyatta International Airport and Wilson Airport. Tell us the address when you enquire and we confirm the pick-up time with your quote.
How far in advance should I book?+
As early as you can, because the Sheldrick elephant orphanage requires advance booking and its slots sell out in high season. Game drives and day trips can often be arranged at short notice, but short notice narrows what we can include.
How do I pay?+
[PLACEHOLDER: state accepted payment methods, deposit requirements and cancellation terms.]

Not sure which day to pick?

Tell us how many hours you have, who is travelling and what you most want to see. We will recommend one of the four and explain why the others fit less well.
